entries.license: MIT for mit-final and earlier; current main AGPL-3.0-or-later
entries.notes: Current LICENSE says mit-final and earlier are MIT, but the remote tag is not currently exposed/resolvable. Do not select by tag name; use the separately verified e520568 MIT commit entry.

entries.name: Cosmos browser universe engine
entries.notes: Current MIT main audited locally on 2026-11-22. Strong modular engine: camera-relative coordinates, scale regimes, tile streaming, shaders, tests, thin React canvas. Internal packages compile and Vite bundle runs, but repo-wide typecheck currently fails in SearchPanel on stale ApiEntity fields; full star-tile data also expects a backend manifest. Better subsystem donor than immediate mother product today.

entries.name: Your Eyes In Space — verified MIT commit e520568
entries.license: MIT source at e520568; bundled HYG-derived stars.bin is CC BY-SA 4.0; NASA assets/data retain their own notices
covers: deterministic procedural star field and systems
entries.notes: Code-level and runtime verified on 2026-11-22: npm ci/build passes; headless browser boots; a minimal public registerExtraSystem patch successfully injected HELION + AURORA-01 and the stock renderer displayed the Hero planet. Main bundle ~2.54 MB; 449 MB dist is dominated by optional lessons/tours (~389 MB) that are not needed for Personal Universe.

entries.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive TAP / pscomppars
entries.license: NASA public scientific data / archive terms; attribution retained
entries.notes: Already used by Personal Universe. TAP schema exposes hip_name, hd_name and gaia_dr3_id in pscomppars; 2026-11-22 research found 51/64 nearest snapshot hosts have HIP identifiers and all 51 exactly match the vendored HYG-derived YEIS star binary.
